messages:
jules-auditor: Hi team — SOC2 auditor here. Need evidence that the KMS key backing inference-staging rotated after 2023-11-01 and that RBAC changes for the inference service account were approved and logged. Can we get CloudTrail, k8s audit, and ticket proof? ETA EOD?
erin: Hi @jules-auditor — we can provide that. Quick clarification: scope = inference-staging only (inference-api + model-cache)?
jules-auditor: Yes, inference-staging only. Also need the approver identity and whether rotation was manual vs automated.
sam: I’ll pull CloudTrail KMS:RotateKey events and CMK metadata, k8s audit logs for RoleBinding changes, and export the ticket (RED-3456) with the approval thread. Will upload presigned artifacts. ETA ~3h.
maria: FYI the rotation was kicked by our 'key-rotator' Lambda on 2024-01-12, but it only runs after an approval flag is added in the ticket. Ticket contains the approval note.
erin: RBAC change details: we rotated the inference service account token and tightened the RoleBinding on 2024-02-10. Quick command to show the binding locally:
```
kubectl get rolebinding inference-binding -o yaml
```
sam: Uploading artifacts now: CloudTrail ZIP, k8s-audit snippet, ticket export, and the signed rotation manifest. Presigned links (expire in 7d):
https://s3.redwood-company/internal/audit/1765432105/cloudtrail-kms-rotate.zip
https://s3.redwood-company/internal/audit/1765432105/k8s-audit-inference-sa.json
https://s3.redwood-company/internal/audit/1765432105/RED-3456-export.pdf
https://s3.redwood-company/internal/audit/1765432105/key-rotation-manifest.sig
:lock:
jules-auditor: Got them, thanks. Can you also confirm there were no related vulnerability escalations tied to the rotation window? If there were, please link the vuln triage ticket.
maria: We ran vuln triage during the window — CVE-2023-9999 was flagged earlier but remediated in patch CP-2024-110. Triage ticket: CVT-2024-112. No evidence of exposure during the rotation.
erin: Approval chain extract for RBAC/key rotation (from ticket audit trail): `approver: alex.ops@redwood.com, action: approved, timestamp: 2024-01-12T14:23:00Z`
jules-auditor: Perfect. Last ask: please provide a short runbook snippet describing incident response steps if a KMS compromise is suspected — auditor wants to confirm IR planning.
sam: Runbook excerpt:
- Revoke CMK grants and rotate envelope keys
- Isolate affected services (apply k8s network policy lockdown)
- Trigger forensics collection (CloudTrail, K8s audit, VPC flow logs)
- Escalate to legal/compliance and notify customers if required
I’ll attach the full runbook shortly.
infra-bot: artifact uploaded: https://s3.redwood-company/internal/audit/1765432105/runbook-infra-excerpt.md (checksum: sha256:ab12cdef3456...) :package:
jules-auditor: Thanks everyone — will review the artifacts and reach back if deeper provenance or signatures are needed. Appreciate the quick turnaround :handshake:
